ValidationRule.description: Channel IS Mandatory for CCRM Leads WHEN Type IN (‘Inbound’ OR ‘Inbound/Outbound') THEN values IN (iKnow Telesales, iKnow Commercial, iKnow Branch) WHEN Type IN (‘Outbound’) THEN values IN (iKnow Commercial) OTHERWISE value Not Mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false && NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator") && OR(ISCHANGED(Channel__c),ISCHANGED(Type)) && NOT( ISPICKVAL(Type,'') ) && IF( CASE(Text(Type), "Inbound", CASE(Text(Channel__c), "iKnow Telesales",1, "iKnow Commercial",1, "iKnow Branch",1, "",0, 1), "Inbound / Outbound", CASE(Text(Channel__c), "iKnow Telesales",1, "iKnow Commercial",1, "iKnow Branch",1, "",0, 1), "Outbound", CASE(Text(Channel__c), "iKnow Telesales",0, "iKnow Commercial",1, "iKnow Branch",0, "",0, 1), 1)=0, true, false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid Channel Value with selected Type.
